hypothesis: Remove repeated allocation and general-purpose edge-map work from the bounded clearance searches the current pipeline actually executes, retaining exact native search decisions and physical semantics.

native_source.scope: Only bounded regional repair uses the local kernel; other native repair solvers and whole-board reference validators are unchanged.

evidence.kind: Correctness-only serial operation probes stopped after Joint; no local performance inference

mechanism: Four canonical undirected planar edge orientations per dense node use one byte of known/permitted flags; ordinary full-stack via sites use a separate byte. These are filled only when the native search queries that edge/site.

Reuse one neighbor-id buffer per search, retaining the native neighbor order. Compute identical neighbor coordinates and geometric lower-bound arithmetic before allocating a point, so dominated edges allocate none.

Accumulate zero/one blocker owner costs in scalars, allocating an insertion-ordered owner-max Map only when a second distinct owner is encountered. Retain the same hit ordering, per-owner maxima and final addition order.

Reuse one collision-hit buffer per search. Its two private synchronous consumers exhaust each sorted result before another query, retaining only scalar costs or span indices; there is no external/reentrant query callback.
unchanged: No new routing candidate, candidate-selection policy, path geometry, heuristic, grid, heap policy, cap, layer domain, via history or physical clearance rule.
Sparse grids and blind/buried via layer-pair edges retain the native key representation. This retains their existing domain rather than adding recovery logic.
Every reference DRC, via-pad guard, fixed-copper guard, publication rule and stage/constructor timing boundary remains active. No snapshots are updated.
No cache is shared across mutable scenes or searches; no physical/ownership cache key is introduced.

diagnostics.location: Pipeline9JointDrcRepairSolver.benchmarkDiagnosticCounters aggregates nonvolatile bounded.repairKernelDiagnostics, separate from stable stats

validation: Exact native route arrays, heap-pop/completion stats and hashed ordered cost-callback arguments on 80 dense geometry/grid cases and a sparse >1m-node case.
Exact native negotiation output, work stats and per-search event sequence on coupled same-net/multi-layer/drill scenes, including multi-owner cost-map activation.
Existing bounded physical, zero-budget, fixed/preloaded-copper and incremental-child contracts; TypeScript; package build.
All 15 existing bounded contract/physical fixtures and a nine-test focused group including full sample2/cropped sample15 regional DRC pass; no snapshot updates.

Final-source actual solveAsync(undefined) on SRJ18 sample14 exactly preserves complete output, ordered DRC arrays, stage order, every phase iteration count and total2,648,353 iterations against saved native control. Both retain139 local control DRC errors; this proves parity only, not clean quality or Linux performance. Fresh paired Blacksmith control is required.
After hit-buffer reuse, final18-test group passes1,324 assertions; TypeScript and package build pass.
falsifiers: Any changed native route witness, pop/decision sequence, ordered errors, DRC acceptance or physical geometry disqualifies this semantics-preserving ablation.
Any end-to-end benefit must survive paired Blacksmith benchmarks including construction, losing work, final validation and the hardest boards.
Dense-map removal and owner-map avoidance may be too small a share of geometric query time to deliver a substantial whole-board gain.
performance_claim: None before paired Blacksmith measurement. Serial operation probes establish repeated work and activation, not speed or whole-board correctness.
